observations.description: Ronaldo stands over a free kick; the score is Portugal 2, Spain 3.
Spain form a defensive wall with De Gea positioned behind it.
Ronaldo strikes the free kick over the wall.
The ball goes into the upper corner; Ronaldo turns to celebrate.
The graphic shows Portugal 3, Spain 3; Portugal players celebrate.

lines.text: Ronaldo stands over it. Portugal trail by one.
The wall has to jump. He has to get this up and down.
Oh, what a free kick! Three-three!
Over the wall and into the corner. De Gea can only watch it go.
